## Source snapshot custody complete — 2026-10-08 22:41 UTC

#528 archive and tracked Git source custody is complete locally. #492 is closed completed with published inventory `5264a647a1ff541302e6b0070a73f268a87a4247` and both hosted checks successful. The 605 exact archive inputs (9,044,760,878 bytes) and both frozen distribution snapshots (6,552 files/180 raw symlinks each) are retained at `/workspace/artifacts/pixelelated-release-sources/m7-archives-a7022b76da76a9f6771bb7693d6f6e25854c6731db0750bb46dde29f14d49fce`. Git snapshot03 finished 22:37:06 UTC with all five original rc0 channels; actual host owners 1542320/1542321/1542322/1542352 exited, consumed at22:41:07. It preserves 372 exact tracked Git snapshots,43 root inputs,439 submodule edges and six separately archived extra-cache groups at `/workspace/artifacts/pixelelated-release-sources/m7-git-266c8393884189dec9419628b3e7e527b965598d7b9b31e4ea31fd9af2204dc9`. Every tracked blob/mode/symlink was checked. The sole LFS pointer is Teakra's 357,257,824-byte accuracy-test fixture: actual SM8550 flags disable tools/tests, the payload is absent, and no generated build edge or installed file uses it; preserve its pointer, with no unused download. Original archive01/Git01/Git02 failures remain unchanged. No source, compiler, VM or audit job is active. Next: finish component-to-source mapping,17 licence metadata gaps, extra-cache/prebuilt/Nix/shareware dispositions and independently verified retrieval/backup custody. No RC or publication clearance; #519 still precedes the owner handheld update.

## Scope

Finish #344's component/source publication gate for the qualified VM18, H70002 and SM855003 images. #492 owns completed firmware builds and their exact per-image inventory attachment; this task owns remaining licence/source dispositions and publication custody. The M7 milestone body remains the ordered plan.

The five architecture profiles now map 584 VM, 224 H700 ARM, 615 H700 aarch64, 228 SM8550 ARM and 676 SM8550 aarch64 components. These are per-profile rows, not a unique-component total. The original failed inventory attempts remain unchanged; the final record explicitly composes individually successful reports. No firmware changes or new audit are implied.

Seventeen components lack recipe licence declarations: common-shaders, enet, freej2me-lr, glsl-shaders, harfbuzz-icu, libretro-database, libspeexdsp, libxmp-lite, openbor, opusfile, rclone, retropie-shaders, rocknix-abl, slang-shaders, tailscale, wildmidi and zerotier-one. Notice candidates are retained for 47 component/profile rows; absence or presence of a notice is not a licence conclusion.

Special inputs: ARM compatibility components; LLVM's exact pinned source archive and three installed libraries (the SM8550 unpacked root is absent); FEX's Nix toolchains/archives and 81 referenced store paths; recovered, hash-pinned amd64/arm64 rclone ZIPs that match the unpacked binaries; and exact installed Doom shareware bytes from idtech-lr's unpinned install-time URL. Do not classify a package as build-only merely because it lacks its own image install stamp: vendored/static dependencies require disposition too. A prebuilt archive is not corresponding source.

Can this be done on the VM? This is read-only host/artifact/source work; no physical fact, personal cloud or device mutation is needed. Hardware smoke, #519 owner alignment and publication authorization remain separate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every selected image and ARM compatibility profile has a component inventory tied to its immutable bundle and original input-manifest hash, with a source/licence disposition per component, including embedded/vendored dependencies.
- [ ] The 17 missing declarations and special inputs above have source-cited dispositions and retained exact notices; no recipe-header licence is substituted for the shipped third-party work's licence. Any required product change has its own rebuilt/requalified artifact before release.
- [ ] A fork-owned corresponding-source bundle retains exact fetched source archives/git/submodules, fork patches and build scripts, with machine-readable hashes and a complete component-to-member map. Prebuilt rclone/ABL/shareware assets and Nix inputs are explicitly assessed rather than silently counted as source.
- [ ] Independent retrieval and hash verification of the source bundle pass, and the required backup custody is evidenced; local source-cache existence and public repository visibility alone do not close this criterion.
- [ ] #344, M7, the release manifest/notes and canonical checkpoint link the final inventory, bundle and any remaining physical/publication gates. Publication is not claimed while an unresolved disposition remains.

## Current evidence

Published [final inventory packet](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/5264a647a1ff541302e6b0070a73f268a87a4247/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-final-inventory), with record37852763656 and wordlist37852763594 both successful. Supplement owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-source-supplement-01` completed with all five original rc0 results and actual process cleanup. Older inventory12 is historical and cannot substitute for these images.

The maintained contract is D-WORKFLOW-139 and #344's corresponding-source/component-inventory obligation. This is a concrete implementation child of that existing approved scope, not a new release policy.
